== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Remote (Japanese)|Remote]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67714 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(50, 16, 430, 612)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>45d094b2346c8c1a3c8fabfd6f3d428186c2a6fc2d83bd4baf4ab709091157a1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
